title: oldhorrorvibes
description: Turn Minecraft into a nightmare. A lightweight shader designed to create a cold, disturbing, and claustrophobic atmosphere.
body:
Bring the horror to your world.

Tired of bright, colorful Minecraft? This shader transforms your game into a haunting, cinematic experience. Designed specifically for those who want to turn their survival world into a found-footage horror movie without sacrificing performance.

Key Features:

Cinematic Atmosphere: Features a cold, desaturated color palette to create a constant sense of dread.

Found-Footage Look: Includes subtle film grain, chromatic aberration, and a dynamic vignette to immerse you in the nightmare.

Pulse-Pounding Effects: Features a subtle, pulsing infection effect at the edges of your vision that intensifies the atmosphere.

Performance Focused: Optimized to run smoothly even on mid-range hardware (tested on GTX 1660 Super).

No Dependency on Game Health: The atmosphere is persistent and rhythmic, ensuring you get the full horror experience in any game mode, including Creative.

Requirements:

Iris Shaders or OptiFine.

Minecraft 1.16.5+ (works best with low-light environments).

Perfect for:

Horror map creators.

Players looking to make their survival playthroughs significantly scarier.

Those who want high-quality atmosphere without heavy performance hits.
